data.label: Failed jobs
data.description: A change to a website, a database or a server did not complete.

data.label: Failed backups
data.description: A backup of a website did not complete.

data.label: Certificates that expire soon
data.description: The TLS certificate of a domain expires in 14 days or less, or the panel could not get one.

data.label: Account suspended
data.description: The account is suspended, and its websites are stopped.

data.label: Suspension lifted
data.description: The suspension of the account is lifted.

data.label: Sign-in from a new device
data.description: Someone signed in to your user from a device or browser that the panel does not know.

data.label: Usage alerts
data.description: A website, a database server or a mailbox uses almost all of its limit.

data.label: Deploys that need attention
data.description: A deploy ran a database migration, and then the website failed its health check. The panel did not go back to the previous release.

data.label: Websites that are down
data.description: An uptime check of a website failed a number of times in a row.

data.label: Websites that are up again
data.description: A website that was down answers its uptime check again.

data.label: Password reset
data.description: Someone asked for a link to set a new password for your user.
